issues.explanation: Members tabs feature is entirely absent: no change to App\Livewire\Entity\Members (activeTab/setActiveTab) and no tabs UI.
Queue list rows use div.box with wire:click instead of the required button.button.is-fullwidth.p-3.mb-2 with wire:click=openQueue(id).
Contract requires public editingQueueId but component defines public bool editingQueue, so contract tests fail.
Contract requires startRename($id) but implementation takes no argument and reads viewingQueueId.
Contract requires toggleActive($id) but implementation takes no argument; Blade calls toggleActive with no id.
Rename passes null as slug to UpdateQueue instead of re-deriving slug from the new name, so renaming Old to New never yields slug new and collisions are not handled.

Serve render resolves selectedQueueId with scoped findOrFail and no call-authorization check, so a tampered id throws 404 instead of showing only ui.serve_empty and discloses tickets of queues the user may not call.
Serve empty state is hardcoded No tickets. instead of ui.serve_empty, and @if ($tickets) is truthy for an empty collection so the empty state never renders.
Serve call-next button is hardcoded Call next with no ui.serve_call_next key and no aria-label.
Serve callNext has no rate limiting although the task requires throttling successful calls per user and entity.
Serve lastCalledTicketId is public without #[Locked] although the task says it is not writable by the client.
Serve mode is never validated and CallMode::from($this->mode) throws ValueError on tampered input instead of failing validation.
Queues startRename resolves the queue scoped but never authorizes update, disclosing the queue name without permission.
Navbar queues link uses @can('Queue::class', $entity) with the class as ability name instead of create on Queue, so managers never see the link.

Queues deactivate/reactivate button and several other controls use hardcoded English (Deactivate, Active, Cancel, Grant) instead of ui.queues_deactivate and other lang keys; access view references non-existent ui.call.
No Pest/PHPUnit tests ship with the change, including the required unauthorized-call and tamper tests for Livewire actions.
No docs or CHANGELOG update although conventions require keeping docs in sync.
Unused imports (Gate in Queues; Queue, Ticket, Gate in Serve) and fully qualified class names despite imports.

conventions.evidence: app/Livewire/Entity/Queues.php:71 uses CreateQueue/UpdateQueue/SetQueueAccess and #[Validate], but Blade hardcodes English (queues.blade.php:52 'Deactivate', serve.blade.php:24 'Call next', serve.blade.php:59 'No tickets.') instead of lang keys, no docs/CHANGELOG, validateOnly vs validate pattern

readability.evidence: app/Livewire/Entity/Serve.php:257 fully-qualified \App\Models\UserRole, unused imports Gate/Queue/Ticket; resources/views/livewire/entity/queues.blade.php:28 div.box vs sibling button style

requirements.evidence: Missing Members tabs entirely; app/Livewire/Entity/Queues.php:40 editingQueue vs editingQueueId, :117 startRename() without $id, :137 UpdateQueue slug null not re-derived, :154 toggleActive() without $id; resources/views/livewire/entity/queues.blade.php:28 div not required button; resources/views/livewire/entity/serve.blade.php:59 hardcoded empty text

scope.evidence: All hunks (Queues.php, Serve.php, lang/ui.php, navbar, queues/serve blades, routes/web.php) serve the task; no unrelated refactors

security.evidence: app/Livewire/Entity/Serve.php:287 render findOrFail without authorize call leaks tickets; :238 lastCalledTicketId not #[Locked]; :264 callNext no RateLimiter; :275 CallMode::from unvalidated; app/Livewire/Entity/Queues.php:117 startRename no authorize

simplicity.evidence: app/Livewire/Entity/Serve.php:261 per-queue QueueAccess exists query (N+1) instead of a join/whereHas; extra getQueuesProperty is fine but fully-qualified names add noise

tests.evidence: change.diff has no tests/* hunks; no happy-path, validation, unauthorized-call or tamper tests for Queues/Serve

review.summary: Adds Queues and Serve Livewire components with routes, lang keys and navbar entries, but misses the Members tabs feature entirely, breaks the Queues/Serve contracts (editingQueueId, startRename/toggleActive signatures, slug re-derivation, empty-state and i18n texts) and leaves a Serve render authorization bypass plus missing rate limiting with no tests.
